stories.title: FGR detiene a exsecretario del Ayuntamiento de Torreón y su esposa; no precisa el delito

en.title: FGR detains former secretary of Torreón Municipality and his wife; does not specify the crime
en.summary: Mexican authorities arrested José Elías Gánem Guerrero, who served as municipal secretary until August 2025, and Martha Rodríguez, who headed the Municipal Justice Center until September 2025, without disclosing the charges.

stories.title: Chivas derrota a Pumas con doblete de Santiago Sandoval y es el nuevo líder del Apertura 2026

en.title: Chivas defeats Pumas with Santiago Sandoval's brace and becomes new leader of Apertura 2026
en.summary: Guadalajara defeated Pumas to take first place in the Apertura 2026 tournament standings, with 19-year-old academy player Santiago Sandoval scoring twice in the match.

stories.title: Exhibe Chivas a Pumas y es nuevo líder del Apertura 2026

en.title: Chivas dominates Pumas and becomes new leader of Apertura 2026
en.summary: Guadalajara secured first place in the Apertura 2026 standings with a 3-0 victory over Pumas, featuring a double by Sandoval and a goal from Gutiérrez before the Classic matchup.

stories.title: Isaac Del Toro hace historia como el primer mexicano en ganar el Gran Premio de Montreal

en.title: Isaac Del Toro makes history as the first Mexican to win the Grand Prix of Montreal
en.summary: Isaac Del Toro from Ensenada became the youngest cyclist ever to win the Grand Prix of Montreal, achieving the victory at age 22 years and 290 days.

stories.title: Asesinan en Morelos a estudiante española de intercambio

en.title: Spanish exchange student killed in Morelos
en.summary: A Spanish university student participating in an exchange program at UAEM was killed with a bladed weapon in Cuautla, Morelos, according to state authorities.

stories.title: Alexander Zverev conquista el US Open y su segundo título de Grand Slam

en.title: Alexander Zverev wins US Open and his second Grand Slam title
en.summary: German tennis player Alexander Zverev achieved victory at the US Open, securing his second Grand Slam title and avenging a 2020 loss to Dominic Thiem.

en.title: Chivas 3 vs Pumas 0: LIVE - Matchday 8 of the 2026 Apertura tournament in Liga MX
en.summary: Chivas and Pumas faced each other at Estadio Akron during the eighth matchday of the 2026 Apertura tournament in Mexico's top football league.

stories.title: Trump critica a Zelenski y a quienes buscan ralentizar la IA durante su visita a Irlanda

en.title: Trump criticizes Zelenski and those seeking to slow AI development during Ireland visit
en.summary: Donald Trump criticized the Ukrainian president and called those opposing rapid artificial intelligence development "negative forces" during the final day of his visit to Ireland.

stories.title: Conquista Zverev el US Open y se lleva su segundo Grand Slam

en.title: Zverev Conquers US Open and Claims His Second Grand Slam
en.summary: Alexander Zverev won the US Open by defeating Ben Shelton, securing his second Grand Slam title of the season and his career.

stories.title: Embiste Isaac del Toro en Montreal

en.title: Isaac del Toro wins in Montreal
en.summary: Isaac del Toro won the Montreal Grand Prix, becoming the first Mexican to achieve this victory, which was his 12th win of the season.

stories.title: Matan a estudiante española durante asalto en Morelos; fiscalía investiga el crimen como feminicidio

en.title: Spanish Student Killed During Robbery in Morelos; Authorities Investigate Crime as Femicide
en.summary: A Spanish student was killed during a robbery in Morelos, Mexico, with authorities investigating the incident as a potential femicide.

stories.title: Protestan miles en Dublín contra visita de Donald Trump a Irlanda

en.title: Thousands Protest in Dublin Against Donald Trump's Visit to Ireland
en.summary: More than 10,000 people demonstrated in Dublin's streets against U.S. President Donald Trump's visit to Ireland for a golf tournament at one of his resorts.

stories.title: NFL México 2026: la lista de precios de los boletos para ver a los 49ers vs. Vikings

en.title: NFL Mexico 2026: Ticket Price List for 49ers vs. Vikings Game
en.summary: Ticket sales for the 2026 NFL game in Mexico between the 49ers and Vikings will begin September 14 with American Express, followed by other payment methods, with public sales opening September 22.

en.summary: Anthropic's CEO proposes that AI companies maintain development while reducing pace to allow for stronger safety testing and measures.

en.title: Do Banks Open on September 15 and 16? Not All Operate the Same
en.summary: Banks will provide limited services on September 15 and 16 during the national holidays. Customer service options through ATMs and branches will vary by institution.

stories.title: Trump no contempla salir del T-MEC y promete una excelente relación con México, pero golpea a Canadá

en.title: Trump Does Not Contemplate Leaving USMCA and Promises Excellent Relations with Mexico, but Targets Canada
en.summary: Trump indicated he does not plan to withdraw from USMCA and stated he will maintain positive relations with Mexico. Simultaneously, he raised new complaints against Canada during the trade agreement review.

stories.title: Este seguro escolar gratuito cubre hasta 40,000 pesos a estudiantes, ¿cómo funciona y quién puede usarlo?

en.title: This Free School Insurance Covers Up to 40,000 Pesos for Students—How Does It Work and Who Can Use It?
en.summary: A free insurance program provides coverage of up to 40,000 pesos to students for school-related accidents. Protection is subject to specific conditions and does not cover all circumstances.
